name_en:
A great tengu from Mount Kurama that has become a Guardian Spirit. Only tengu with superlative spiritual power come to be known as great tengu, and they were revered as mountain gods in many regions across Japan. Great tengu come in many forms, including Hanataka Tengu, with incredibly long, red noses, or the half-man, half-bird Karasu Tengu. There were also some that so closely resembled birds or humans that they could not be identified as tengu from their appearance alone.

As is the case with many yokai, some tengu become friendly nigitama while others become malevolent aratama. Tengu that become aratama delight in the panic that ensues from conflict and conflagration. However, those that become nigitama protect the sacred grounds of mountains and forests, guiding practitioners along the path to enlightenment. The well-known legend of the Kurama Tengu schooling the young Minamoto no Yoshitsune in the fighting arts is one such case.
name_ja: 鞍馬天狗は鞍馬山に住んでいた大天狗が守護霊となったもの。特に強大な神通力を持つ天狗は大天狗と呼ばれ、多くの地方で山の神として崇められる。その姿はさまざまで、顔が赤く鼻が長い鼻高天狗や、半人半鳥の烏天狗が多いとされるが、より鳥に近い姿のものや、普通の人間と見分けがつかないものもいるという。多くの妖怪がそうであるように、天狗にも荒魂の側面と和魂の側面がある。荒魂の天狗は火事や争乱で人々が慌て騒ぐことを好み、世に混乱を巻き起こすとされるが、和魂の天狗は山や森などの霊域の秩序を守り、その地で修行する者を教え導くという。鞍馬山の天狗が牛若丸（源義経の幼名）に兵法を教えたという伝説は広く知られている。

boss_text: a yokai and its master (Ninja Yoki per GamingBolt)
name_en: Kongojishi is a guardian spirit that takes the form of a lion, king of the beasts and an auspicious animal. Kongo means "the sturdiest of things" and comes from the Japanese word for vajra, a weapon wielded by the thunder god of Tianzhu. Thus in Buddhism, the Kongo came to represent devout practitioners of the Buddha's teachings. The lion, or shishi, is also known as a protector of the Buddha, and likewise, it is said that Kongojishi will only possess those of steadfast faith. In doing so, Kongojishi guards its master with adamantine strength while using fire and wind alike to eradicate enemies.
name_ja: 金剛獅子は百獣の王たる瑞獣、獅子の守護霊。金剛とは仏教の総本山である天竺の雷神が持つ武器、金剛杵に由来する言葉で、「最も堅固なもの」を意味する。そこから、仏教では仏道を修めた者の揺るがぬ心を示すようになった。獅子は仏の守護者であるともされる。金剛獅子も強い信念を持つ傑物にのみ憑くといわれ、その金剛のごとき堅固さで主を守り、火と風とを操ってあらゆる敵を打ち破る。
